name: trading212-mcp
description: Read and optionally manage your Trading212 account (cash, positions, orders, pies, history) directly in Claude.

api_key.title: Live API Key
api_key.description: Basic-auth credential from your Trading212 live account (Settings → API), base64-encoded as key:secret. Only used when 'Use live account' is on.

demo_api_key.title: Demo API Key
demo_api_key.description: Basic-auth credential from your Trading212 demo/practice account, base64-encoded as key:secret. Only used when 'Use live account' is off (the default). Live and demo keys are separate — only one is active at a time, based on the toggle below.

use_live_account.title: Use live account
use_live_account.description: Off (default): read from your Trading212 demo/practice account using the Demo API Key. On: read from your real live account using the Live API Key.

enable_order_write_tools.title: Enable order write tools (place/cancel orders)
enable_order_write_tools.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can place and cancel orders — every such action still requires your explicit approval in Claude Desktop before it runs. Order limitations: orders can only be executed in the account's main currency.

enable_pie_write_tools.title: Enable pie write tools (create/update/delete/duplicate pies)
enable_pie_write_tools.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can create, update, delete, and duplicate pies — every such action still requires your explicit approval in Claude Desktop before it runs.
